approved_amendments.scope: Implement and activate the scheduled monthly review-and-cleanup process defined in REP-STEWARD-027-WCS-001.
limits: Run on the last calendar day of each month in Asia/Singapore time.
Never recommend or delete production artifacts.
Never recommend or delete artifacts 90 days old or newer.
Unknown or unverifiable production status, age, ownership, references, or recovery value must fail closed.
Create the dated recommendation register before cleanup and record every deletion.
Do not invoke existing broad cleanup scripts.

execution.objective: Implement and activate a recurring monthly repository hygiene review-and-cleanup process with a complete recommendation register and strict non-production and age eligibility gates.

deletion_policy.age: Artifacts 90 days old or newer must never be recommended or deleted. Recommend or delete only when reliable creation evidence proves age is greater than 90 days.
deletion_policy.approval_model: One approved recurring WCS authorizes the eligible list as a whole; no per-item approval.
deletion_policy.irreversibility: Permanent deletion; record each deleted path and evidence in durable cycle output.
deletion_policy.recommendation_eligibility: Recommend and delete only when reliable evidence establishes non-production status and age greater than 90 days at run time.

success_criteria: Materialize the review-and-cleanup procedure, read-only inventory, cleanup executor, review template, and monthly schedule definition.
Review and classify candidates before cleanup on each scheduled run.
Generate a complete dated report and machine-readable register before deleting anything.
Never include production artifacts or artifacts 90 days old or newer in the cleanup recommendation list or deletion set.
Delete only paths present in that run's register with verified non-production status and reliable evidence of age greater than 90 days.
Exclude tracked or otherwise protected source-of-record items unless the implementation defines an explicit, auditable eligibility rule for them.
Fail closed when age, production status, ownership, references, or recovery value cannot be established.
Never invoke existing broad cleanup scripts.
Record schedule execution, candidate evidence, and each deletion in durable cycle evidence.
Do not change Builder behavior, runtime, packages, database, Supabase, or deployment.
proposed_outputs: A last-calendar-day monthly schedule definition and durable run-evidence location
execution.verification_profile: SCHEDULE_BOUNDARY; PRODUCTION_EXCLUSION; STRICT_90_DAY_GATE; FAIL_CLOSED; REGISTER_BEFORE_DELETE; DELETION_AUDIT_TRAIL

depends_on: REP-STEWARD-026-WCS-001 Approved Monthly Review and Cleanup Policy
unlocks: Recurring scheduled monthly review and cleanup after this WCS is separately approved and implementation verification passes.

authorized_surface: A last-calendar-day monthly schedule definition and durable run-evidence location
proposed_surface_if_approved: A last-calendar-day monthly schedule definition and durable run-evidence location
forbidden_surface: Candidates with unknown age or production status
Candidates with uncertain ownership, references, or recovery value
Recommendation or deletion of production artifacts
Recommendation or deletion of artifacts 90 days old or newer

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: Validate eligibility decisions and scheduling without deleting repository files during setup.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Draft implementation WCS is staged; no schedule is activated and no cleanup is run.
